# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
a. Clearly indicate the date and time of the inspection.
b. State the make, model, year, and vehicle identification number (VIN) along with the registration plate number.
c. Record the odometer reading at the start of the inspection.

3. Detail the brake system assessment section.
a. List the components of the brake system that were evaluated, such as:
   - Brake pads and shoes
   - Rotors and drums
   - Brake lines and hoses
   - Brake fluid level and condition
   - Master cylinder
   - Calipers
   - Wheel cylinders
   - Parking brake
   - Anti-lock braking system (ABS) sensors, if applicable

4. Document observed issues.
a. Note any visible defects, such as:
   - Fluid leaks
   - Cracked, worn, or missing components
   - Rust or corrosion on components
   - Excessively worn pads or shoes
